caption: The drawing features two renderings of the same garment, which appears to be a long-sleeved, buttoned bodice with a collar. The main, larger rendering is located in the upper left quadrant of the composition and is colored. This bodice is primarily patterned with vertical blue and gray stripes. The collar is white with a lace-like texture. There is a horizontal black band with brown edging across the chest, upper arms, and cuffs. Decorative slits with brown edging are present along the arms and at the cuffs. Below and to the right of this main colored drawing, there is a smaller, monochromatic sketch of the same bodice, rendered with fine lines in gray pencil, showing the back view of the garment with similar horizontal band and stripe patterns. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery depicted.
title: Taffeta Waist
